title: Hampta Pass Trek
reportingPoint: Manali. Pickup is arranged between 6:00 AM and 8:00 AM on Day 1. The exact pickup point is shared once your booking is confirmed.
highlights: Camps at Chika, Balu Ka Ghera, Sia Goru and Chatru
Visit to Chandra Tal, if road and weather conditions permit
Views of Indrasan Peak and its glacier from the pass
A route that goes from the pine forests near Manali to the dry landscape of Lahaul and Spiti
All 3 meals plus snacks, permits, trekking equipment and a certified trek leader
overview:
The Hampta Pass trek starts in the pine forests near Manali and ends in the dry, desert-like landscape on the Spiti side, crossing the pass at 14,100 ft (4,298 m). From Manali it is a **4 Nights / 5 Days** trek, Manali to Manali. On the Manali package you reach Manali on your own, and pickup is arranged between 6:00 AM and 8:00 AM on Day 1. A package from Delhi is also offered. Batches run from May to September, with departures every day.

Day 1 is the 16 km drive to Jobra and a 2 km trek to Chika campsite. Day 2 is the trek to Balu Ka Ghera. Day 3 crosses Hampta Pass and descends to Sia Goru. Day 4 descends to Chatru, with a visit to Chandra Tal if road and weather conditions permit. Day 5 is the 85 km drive back to Manali. Transfers from Manali, camping, meals, permits, trekking equipment and a trek leader are included. Prices start at ₹6,499 per person from Manali and ₹9,499 from Delhi (5% GST extra); dual sharing accommodation costs ₹1,000 extra per person.

itinerary.title: Manali to Jobra by road | Trek to Chika
itinerary.content:
Altitude: Manali 6,730 ft / 2,050 m, Jobra 9,800 ft / 2,987 m, Chika 10,100 ft / 3,078 m.
Altitude gain: 3,070 ft / 937 m from Manali to Jobra and 300 ft / 91 m from Jobra to Chika.
Distance: about 16 km by road from Manali to Jobra, then a 2 km trek to Chika. Total time: 4-5 hours including the drive.
Trek grade: easy to moderate, a gradual ascent suitable for beginners and first-time trekkers.
Pickup from Manali between 6:00 AM and 8:00 AM.
Drive to Jobra past forests and apple orchards.
Trek from Jobra through pine forest, over wooden bridges and across open meadows.
Reach Chika campsite beside the Rani Nallah stream.
Dinner and overnight stay at the campsite.

itinerary.title: Chika to Balu Ka Ghera
itinerary.content:
Altitude: Chika 10,100 ft / 3,078 m, Balu Ka Ghera 11,900 ft / 3,627 m. Altitude gain: 1,800 ft / 549 m.
Trek distance: 8.5 km. Trek duration: around 6 hours.
Trek grade: gradual to moderate.
After breakfast, start a mild hike that runs through forest for most of the way.
The Dhauladhar range and snow-capped peaks come into view as you climb.
Reach the meadows at Balu Ka Ghera and pitch tents for the night.
Meals: breakfast, lunch and dinner.

itinerary.title: Balu Ka Ghera to Sia Goru over Hampta Pass
itinerary.content:
Altitude: Balu Ka Ghera 11,900 ft / 3,627 m, Hampta Pass 14,100 ft / 4,298 m, Sia Goru 12,900 ft / 3,932 m.
Altitude gain: 2,200 ft / 662 m from Balu Ka Ghera to Hampta Pass, then a 1,200 ft / 366 m descent to Sia Goru.
Trek distance: 7 km. Trek duration: approximately 10 hours.
Trek grade: moderate to difficult.
Climb to Hampta Pass, with views of Indrasan Peak and its glacier.
It is usually windy and cold at the top, so the group doesn't stay long.
From the crest, look out over the barren landscape of Lahaul and Spiti.
Descend to the Sia Goru campsite in about 2 hours. The path is slippery and rocky, so go carefully; the descent is hard on the knees.
Meals: breakfast, lunch and dinner. Overnight stay at the campsite.

itinerary.title: Sia Goru to Chatru | Chandra Tal visit
itinerary.content:
Trek duration: 6 to 7 hours.
Trek from Sia Goru to Chatru, a relatively easy descent through the Hampta Valley.
The Pir Panjal range is ahead of you until you reach the Chatru campsite, with wildflowers and small streams along the path.
Chatru is a junction on the routes to Rohtang Pass, Hampta Pass and Spiti.
If road and weather conditions permit, travel from Chatru to Chandra Tal.
After time at the lake, return to Chatru for the night.
Meals: breakfast, lunch and dinner. Overnight stay at the campsite.

itinerary.title: Chatru to Manali
itinerary.content:
Altitude: Chatru 11,000 ft / 3,353 m, Manali 6,730 ft / 2,050 m. Altitude difference: 4,270 ft / 1,303 m.
Distance: 85 km by road. Time taken: approximately 4-7 hours.
Drive from the Chatru campsite back to Manali.
Reach Manali late in the afternoon, where the trek ends.
Meals: breakfast only. Lunch on the way is not included.

faqs.q: Where does the trek start, and how do I reach?
faqs.a: The trek runs Manali to Manali. On the Manali package you reach Manali on your own, and pickup is arranged from Manali between 6:00 AM and 8:00 AM on Day 1. The exact pickup point is shared once your booking is confirmed. A package from Delhi is also available.

faqs.q: How much does the Hampta Pass Trek cost?
faqs.a: From Manali it is ₹6,499 per person, and from Delhi it is ₹9,499 per person. Dual sharing accommodation is ₹1,000 extra per person, which makes it ₹7,499 from Manali and ₹10,499 from Delhi. 5% GST is extra.

Day 1 from Jobra to Chika is easy to moderate and suitable for beginners and first-time trekkers. Day 2 to Balu Ka Ghera is gradual to moderate. Day 3, the pass crossing, is moderate to difficult: 7 km in approximately 10 hours.
Hampta Pass, at 14,100 ft / 4,298 m. The camps are at Chika (10,100 ft), Balu Ka Ghera (11,900 ft), Sia Goru (12,900 ft) and Chatru (11,000 ft).
The plan for Day 4 is to travel from Chatru to Chandra Tal and return to Chatru for the night. This happens only if road and weather conditions permit.

Pick-up and drop transfers from Manali to Manali, camping in dome tents (triple sharing) or alpine tents (quad sharing), all 3 meals plus snacks, trekking and forest permits, campsite fees, trekking equipment, a certified trek leader, a trek crew, safety gear and a trek certificate of completion. Day 1 has dinner only and Day 5 has breakfast only.

faqs.q: How do I book and pay?
faqs.a: Reserve your seat by paying 50% of the trip cost, and pay the rest at least 4 days before the trip. 5% GST is added to the price.

Cancel more than 10 days before the travel date and 50% of the advance is refunded; 5 to 10 days before, 25% of the advance; less than 5 days before, there is no refund. There is no refund for no-shows or early check-outs.
